captions.detailed: This 3D model features an angle-lock drill bench vise mounted on a swivel base. The assembly includes a flat grey rectangular base plate, a blue circular swivel plate, a main blue vise body with a fixed rear jaw, a sliding front jaw, and a black handwheel on the side. The upper vise body rotates about the vertical swivel-base joint, the front jaw moves linearly to clamp workpieces, and the handwheel rotates continuously on its screw axis.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated 3D model of a drill bench vise. It should feature a grey rectangular base, a rotating blue circular swivel base, a blue main vise body with a fixed rear jaw, a sliding front jaw (prismatic joint), and a black handwheel (continuous rotational joint) on the side.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly starting with a flat rectangular plate for the base, followed by a low cylinder for the swivel plate. The main vise body is built using boolean combinations of box primitives to form the fixed jaw and central guide track. The sliding jaw is constructed as a separate box-like part aligned with the track. The handwheel is created using concentric cylinders and spokes, connected to the main body via a continuous rotational joint.
